title: Minimum T-depth of Quantum AES Under Round Boundaries
summary: An improved quantum AES construction uses a theoretically minimal T-depth-3 S-box; prove or disprove its overall T-depth minimality when optimization stays within AES round boundaries.

formal_statement.body: Prove or disprove that the improved quantum AES circuit construction based on an AES S-box circuit of $T$-depth $3$ has minimum $T$-depth among quantum AES circuits optimized without crossing the natural hierarchical boundaries formed by AES round functions; equivalently, any further $T$-depth reduction requires optimization across those boundaries.

scope.domain: Quantum circuit synthesis and T-depth optimization for AES.
assumptions: Optimization does not cross the natural hierarchical boundaries formed by AES round functions.
parameters: T-depth 3: the T-depth of the AES S-box circuit underlying the improved construction
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove or disprove that the construction has minimum T-depth under the restriction against optimization across AES round-function boundaries.

citations.label: Synthesizing Quantum Circuits of AES with Lower T-depth and Less Qubits

progress.summary: After reporting improved AES circuits and an AES S-box circuit of T-depth 3, the source explicitly conjectures that no further T-depth reduction is possible without optimization across round-function boundaries.
citation_labels: Zhenyu Huang et al., Synthesizing Quantum Circuits of AES with Lower T-depth and Less Qubits
